title: Import my portfolio
description: Bring in your buildings, units, signed leases and tenants from a CSV file. Nothing is saved before you confirm.

upload.title: 1. File
upload.description: A CSV file (UTF-8 or Windows-1252), at most 2 MB and 1,000 rows. One row per unit, with its lease and up to 4 tenants.
upload.label: CSV file
upload.hint: The columns of the TAL form (address, term, rent, services, rooms, pets) are recognised. What is missing stays to complete on the lease.

invalid.size: The file is larger than 2 MB.

refusals.fileEmpty: We cannot read this file. Use the Escalia template.
refusals.tooManyRows: The file has more than 1,000 rows. Split it into several files.
refusals.tooBig: The file is larger than 2 MB.
refusals.purged: The file was deleted 7 days after the import.
refusals.mapping: Map at least the address, the unit, the start of the lease and the rent, each field once.
refusals.notFound: This import does not exist, or it does not belong to your organization.

mapping.title: 2. Columns
mapping.intro: Choose the field each column fills. Columns you ignore are not read.

report.title: 4. Report
report.invite: Your tenants have not been invited yet. Check their contact details, then invite them from the lease.

run: Import {count, plural, one {# ready row} other {# ready rows}}

rowErrors.due_day: The due day is from 1 to 28.
rowErrors.rooms: The number of rooms is from 1 to 30.
rowErrors.reach: Give an email or a phone for this tenant.
rowErrors.end_before_start: The lease ends before it starts.
rowErrors.other: This row is refused (address outside Quebec, a lease that overlaps another, or a portfolio rule).
